verdict.rationale: Statsig ingests and stores user event and exposure data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, retention periods, or user/event data deletion capability. The Console API's CRUD actions cover console entities such as gates and experiments, not ingested data, so they are only adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
